Best ihram slipper Experience maximum comfort and reliability during your sacred journey with the Best Ihram Slipper BD, specially designed for Hajj and Umrah pilgrims. Made from high-quality EVA material and available in sizes 38 to 45, this ihram slipper is ideal for Bangladeshi pilgrims who need durable, lightweight, and Shariah-compliant footwear for long hours of walking and worship.
The Best Ihram Slipper BD follows all Ihram footwear guidelines. Its open design keeps the necessary parts of the foot exposed, making it fully permissible to wear during Ihram. The clean white color and simple, elegant look perfectly match Ihram clothing.It maintain a respectful appearance throughout Hajj and Umrah rituals.
Best Ihram Slipper BD – Premium EVA Material | Size 38–45 | Comfortable & Shariah-Compliant
Crafted with soft yet strong EVA material, this slipper offers excellent cushioning and shock absorption. EVA helps reduce pressure on the heels and joints, making the Best Ihram Slipper BD extremely comfortable for extended walking during Tawaf, Sa’i, and travel between Mina, Arafat, and Muzdalifah. The lightweight design ensures your feet feel relaxed even after long hours of use.
The ergonomic sole structure of the Best Ihram hajj Slipper BD provides good arch support and balance. Its anti-slip outsole delivers strong grip on marble floors, tiled surfaces, and outdoor walkways. Sandals /slippers reducing the risk of slipping in crowded areas. T
Another major advantage of the Best Ihram Slipper BD is its water-resistant and quick-dry nature. It can be used comfortably in ablution areas and is easy to clean after daily use. The EVA material retains its shape and quality even after repeated washing, ensuring long-lasting durability throughout your journey.
Available in a wide size range from 38 to 45, the Best Ihram Sandal BD fits most men comfortably. The flexible design adapts well to different foot shapes, providing a secure and relaxed fit. It is easy to wear, remove, and carry, making it a practical choice for travel.
If you are searching for reliable, comfortable, and affordable Ihram footwear in Bangladesh, the Hajj Ihram Slipper BD (Size 38–45) is the perfect option. Designed for comfort, safety, and religious compliance, this slipper allows you to focus fully on your ibadah with peace of mind.

Monitor your glucose lebel with Ok Match blood glucose diabetes machine kit
Hello dear countrymen, taking care of your health or the health of a loved one is now easier and more reliable. Diabetes is a real part of our lives, and to check it regularly, you need a correct and easy-to-use Diabetes Machine Kit. The Ok Match Blood Glucose Glucometer Kit is here to give you an accurate result and peace of mind.
In this package, you get all the things you need. It includes a high-quality digital display glucometer with a lifetime warranty. With it, you can check your blood glucose lOrdersevel anytime, anywhere, and see it easily. Most importantly, the results are very accurate, which helps you plan your treatment with your doctor.
The kit also has 10 foil strips. Each one is in its own pack, so they last for 1-2 years. You also get 10 lancets and a lancet pen, which are designed to get blood with very little pain. And to keep everything neat, you get a hard carry bag or case that’s easy to take with you.
Ok Match strips are available all over the country, so you don’t have to worry about running out. You can choose between foil strips (for long-term use) or a box of strips (25/50 pieces, which last for 3 months after you open the box).
This Ok Match Diabetes Machine Kit is made in Taiwan and is registered with our country’s drug administration (Darg Regi: 759-6941-2020). This proves its quality and reliability. The Ok Match Glucometer Kit is a smart and good investment for your health or your family’s health. Keep your diabetes in control with regular check-ups and live a healthy life. Now you don’t have to go to a clinic to check your diabetes; your own diabetes machine kit will be right in your home!

products.long_description:
Dua Card For Hajj Umrah BD
Hajj and Umrah Made Easy is a complete practical guide on how to perform Hajj & Umrah presented in a unique, innovative pilgrim-orientated design. Flip format, handheld and with a unique travel cord allowing you to carry it hands free. An ideal companion on your blessed journey! Covers complete Rites of Hajj and Umrah in a clear manner with the aid of dozens of diagrams. Printed in full colour with laminated splash-proof pages.

Fully researched and authoritative guide to Hajj & Umrah
Practical adjustable travel cord for hands free use
Step-by-step guide to Hajj and Umrah ideal for first timers
Robust design with splash-proof pages
Useful sections with health advice, useful Arabic phrases
Includes all du’as, with transliteration for non-Arabic readers

A Dua card for Hajj and Umrah is a specially designed card that contains prayers (duas) and supplications for pilgrims embarking on the sacred journey of Hajj or Umrah. These cards typically feature a selection of prayers recommended to be recited at various stages of the pilgrimage, such as during Tawaf (circumambulation around the Kaaba), Sa’i (walking between the hills of Safa and Marwa), and while standing on the plains of Arafat.
The purpose of a Dua card is to provide pilgrims with easy access to these important prayers, which are considered to be spiritually significant and beneficial during the journey. The cards often include Arabic text for the original prayers, along with transliterations in Bangla to assist pilgrims who may not be proficient in Arabic.
Dua cards for Hajj and Umrah are typically compact and portable, making them convenient for pilgrims to carry with them throughout their journey. They serve as a reminder of the spiritual significance of the pilgrimage and help pilgrims stay connected to their faith through regular recitation of these sacred prayers.
English Version Book

Don’t sacrifice another moment of comfort. Invest in durability, simplicity, and portability. Order your inflatable travel pillow today and transform the way you travel.

Plain Egyptian 100% cotton Ihram cloth is one of the most sought-after varieties of Ihram cloth due to its superior quality and comfort.In Bangladesh, there are several stores that sell Plain Egyptian 100% cotton Ihram cloth for Hajj and Umrah. The cloth is made from 100% pure Egyptian cotton, which is renowned for its softness, durability, and breathability.One of the main advantages of Plain Egyptian 100% cotton Ihram cloth is its ability to absorb sweat and keep the body cool and dry. This is especially important during the hot and humid weather conditions that pilgrims often encounter during the Hajj and Umrah. The cloth is also easy to wash and maintain, making it a practical choice for frequent use.In addition to its practical benefits, Plain Egyptian 100% cotton Ihram cloth is also considered a symbol of purity and simplicity. The white color represents the pilgrim’s intention to purify their heart and soul while the unsewn nature of the cloth represents the equality of all pilgrims before God.Overall, the sale of Plain Egyptian 100% cotton Ihram cloth in Bangladesh is an essential service for Muslim pilgrims preparing for the Hajj and Umrah. The high-quality, breathable, and comfortable fabric ensures that pilgrims can focus on their religious duties without worrying about discomfort or irritation.

Collapsible Water Bottle, Silicone Foldable Water Bottles For Travel, Easy-To-Carry Design And Compact Size
Compact Design: This 600 ml collapsible silicone water bottle folds down to a compact size, making it perfect for easy storage and portability. Lightweight and foldable, it’s designed to fit seamlessly into your backpack, suitcase, or purse, compressing to 1/5 of its original size.
Safe and Durable: Made from high-quality, food-grade silicone, this reusable water bottle is BPA-free and shatterproof, ensuring safe, long-lasting use.
Versatile: The flexible silicone material allows the bottle to twist and fold into various shapes without compromising its 20 oz capacity. It’s ideal for camping, hiking, biking, the gym, and all your indoor or outdoor adventures.
Leak-Proof: Equipped with a secure twist cap, this bottle prevents spills and leaks, providing a reliable, flexible, and shatterproof hydration solution.
Easy to Clean: Thanks to its silicone material and wide mouth, this bottle is easy to clean and maintain. Available in a range of stylish colors, it’s a great choice for both adults and children.

Leak-Proof: Equipped with a secure twist cap, this bottle prevents spills and leaks, providing a reliable, flexible, and shatterproof hydration solution.
Easy to Clean: Thanks to its silicone material and wide mouth, this bottle is easy to clean and maintain. Available in a range of stylish colors, it’s a great choice for both adults and children.

Foldable Prayer Mat BD best price offer
Experience comfort and convenience wherever you pray with our premium Folding Prayer Mat BD, specially designed for Muslims who value portability without compromising on quality. With a practical size of 42 inch x 18 inch, this prayer mat offers the perfect balance between compact design and comfortable space for daily Salah, travel, office use, or outdoor prayer.
Crafted from high-quality, soft, and durable fabric, this Foldable Prayer Mat BD ensures a smooth and comfortable surface for your forehead, hands, and knees. The material is lightweight yet sturdy, making it suitable for regular use. Whether you are at home, in the mosque, at work, or on a journey, you can easily carry this mat in your bag without adding extra weight.
Folding Prayer Mat BD Back Support System
One of the standout features of this Foldable Prayer Mat BD is its smart folding design. It can be neatly folded into a compact size within seconds, allowing you to store it effortlessly in your backpack, handbag, or travel luggage. This makes it an excellent choice for students, office professionals, travelers, and Hajj or Umrah pilgrims who need a reliable and portable prayer solution.
The 42 inch x 18 inch size provides ample space for comfortable prostration while maintaining a slim profile. The elegant Islamic-inspired design adds a spiritual touch, helping you stay focused and connected during your prayers. The stitching is strong and precise, ensuring long-lasting performance even with frequent folding and unfolding.
Our Foldable Prayer Mat BD is easy to clean and maintain. The fabric resists dust and dries quickly, making it ideal for both indoor and outdoor use. Simply fold it after use and keep it safely stored until your next prayer time.
If you are looking for a practical, lightweight, and durable prayer mat in Bangladesh, this Foldable Prayer Mat BD is the perfect choice. It combines functionality, comfort, and portability to support your daily ibadah anytime, anywhere.

ডিওডোরেন্ট স্টিকটির ক্যাপ বা ঢাকনাটি খুলুন। এবার ক্রিস্টাল বা পাথরের ওপরের অংশটিতে সামান্য কয়েক ফোঁটা পানি দিয়ে হালকা ভিজিয়ে নিন। (সতর্কতা: পুরো স্টিকটি পানির নিচে ধরবেন না, শুধু ওপরের অংশটি সামান্য ভেজালেই হবে।

ভেজা ক্রিস্টাল স্টিকটি আপনার বগলের ত্বকে কয়েকবার আলতোভাবে ঘষুন বা ম্যাসাজ করুন। এটি আপনার ত্বকে খনিজ লবণের একটি অদৃশ্য সুরক্ষাকবচ তৈরি করবে, যা ঘামের দুর্গন্ধ রোধ করবে।

ইহরামের অবস্থায় শতভাগ নিরাপদ: এটি সম্পূর্ণ সুবাসহীন (Fragrance-Free) এবং অ্যালকোহলমুক্ত হওয়ায় ইহরাম বাঁধার পর বা ইহরাম অবস্থায় এটি ব্যবহার করা সম্পূর্ণ জায়েজ

Fragnance Free Deodorant Stick: 24-Hour Odor Protection for Hajj & Umrah Pilgrims
Embarking on the sacred journeys of Hajj and Umrah from Bangladesh requires immense spiritual focus, physical endurance, and absolute adherence to the rules of Ihram. In the intense heat of Makkah and Madinah, managing sweat while maintaining ritual purity is a priority for every pilgrim. The Rihala Fragnance Free Deodorant Stick is thoughtfully designed to support Bangladeshi pilgrims every step of the way, offering a reliable, worry-free hygiene solution that completely respects your spiritual boundaries.
Fragnance Free Deodorant Stick 100% Halal & Ihram-Compliant Protection
When entering the state of Ihram, using scented body products is strictly prohibited. This specialized Fragnance Free Deodorant features an entirely unscented formula, crafted from 100% mineral salt. It is certified 100% Halal and contains absolutely zero hidden perfumes, alcohol, or synthetic chemicals. You can apply this crystal deodorant stick with total peace of mind, knowing it fully respects Islamic traditions and the sacred rules of your pilgrimage.
24-Hour Odor Defense in Desert Heat
Performing Tawaf and Sa’i involves miles of walking under extreme temperatures. This mineral deodorant stick provides heavy-duty, 24-hour odor protection by naturally neutralizing the bacteria that cause body odor before it even starts. Instead of masking sweat with heavy artificial perfumes, it creates an invisible, clean barrier that keeps you feeling fresh from Fajr to Isha, even during peak afternoon heat.
Fragnance Free Deodorant Safe for Your Ihram
Our gentle formula is hypoallergenic and exceptionally kind to all skin types, protecting you from underarm chafing during long walks. Because it relies on pure mineral salt rather than harsh chemicals, it dries instantly upon application. It leaves absolutely no sticky residue, chalky white streaks, or yellow stains on your pristine white Ihram garments, ensuring you remain clean, comfortable, and dignified.
Perfect Travel Size for Bangladeshi Pilgrims
The ultra-compact, lightweight 20 gm stick is tailor-made for international travel. It slips effortlessly into your waist pouch, hand luggage, or pocket without taking up precious weight or space. Despite its small 20 gm size, the highly concentrated crystal stone is incredibly long-lasting and will easily endure your entire journey. Simply moisten the tip with a bit of water, apply smoothly to clean skin, and focus entirely on your prayers.

Hajj Shampoo Size: 100 ml/60 mL
Origin: Handmade (bangladesh)
Our Fragrance-Free Hajj Shampoo is the ultimate solution for pilgrims seeking a pure and practical cleansing product during their sacred journey. This handmade shampoo is meticulously formulated with care, ensuring it’s free from all fragrances, in line with the Islamic guidelines for Hajj and Umrah rituals. Whether you’re at home or on your pilgrimage, this shampoo provides a gentle cleanse that leaves your hair feeling fresh, clean, and healthy without any unnecessary additives or strong scents.
This 100ml bottle is the perfect travel companion, compact yet long-lasting, making it ideal for the duration of your Hajj or Umrah pilgrimage. Crafted with the needs of Bangladeshi pilgrims in mind, this shampoo is especially suited for maintaining personal hygiene while observing religious purity.
Experience peace of mind knowing you’re using a fragrance-free shampoo that aligns with your spiritual journey, allowing you to focus on your prayers and rituals.
Why Use Fragrance-Free hajj Shampoo in the State of Ihram During Hajj & Umrah?
When pilgrims enter the state of Ihram during Hajj and Umrah, they adopt a special set of rules meant to purify their body, mind, and spirit for the sacred journey. One of the key restrictions during Ihram is avoiding the use of any products containing fragrances, including perfumes, scented soaps, and shampoos. Here’s why it’s essential to use fragrance-free shampoo in this state:
1. Adherence to Islamic Guidelines
In the state of Ihram, using products with fragrances is strictly prohibited as it can invalidate certain aspects of the pilgrimage. A fragrance-free shampoo ensures that pilgrims remain compliant with these rules, keeping their actions in line with the religious requirements.
2. Maintaining Spiritual Purity
Ihram is not just a physical state but also a spiritual one. Pilgrims are encouraged to focus solely on worship and spiritual reflection. By using a fragrance-free hajj shampoo, pilgrims maintain a sense of purity and avoid distractions that could take away from the solemnity of their journey.
3. Respect for the Sacred Rituals
Fragrances are often associated with luxury and adornment, which contradicts the humility and simplicity of Ihram. Pilgrims are meant to strip away material excesses, presenting themselves in a pure and modest form. A fragrance-free shampoo helps pilgrims embrace this simplicity and avoid unnecessary embellishments.
4. Protecting the Sanctity of Ihram
Using any form of fragrance can inadvertently break the sanctity of Ihram. Since the use of scented products is forbidden, fragrance-free shampoo ensures that pilgrims can maintain cleanliness without compromising the sanctity of their pilgrimage.
5. Avoiding Unintentional Violations
Even a small amount of fragrance can lead to unintentional violations of Ihram rules, which may require compensatory acts (such as a penalty). By choosing a fragrance-free shampoo, pilgrims can prevent accidental breaches of Ihram and focus on their prayers and rituals without concern.

When pilgrims enter the state of Ihram during Hajj and Umrah, they adopt a special set of rules meant to purify their body, mind, and spirit for the sacred journey. One of the key restrictions during Ihram is avoiding the use of any products containing fragrances, including perfumes, scented soaps, and shampoos. Here’s why it’s essential to use fragrance-free shampoo in this state:
1. Adherence to Islamic Guidelines
In the state of Ihram, using products with fragrances is strictly prohibited as it can invalidate certain aspects of the pilgrimage. A fragrance-free shampoo ensures that pilgrims remain compliant with these rules, keeping their actions in line with the religious requirements.
2. Maintaining Spiritual Purity
Ihram is not just a physical state but also a spiritual one. Pilgrims are encouraged to focus solely on worship and spiritual reflection. By using a fragrance-free hajj shampoo, pilgrims maintain a sense of purity and avoid distractions that could take away from the solemnity of their journey.
3. Respect for the Sacred Rituals
Fragrances are often associated with luxury and adornment, which contradicts the humility and simplicity of Ihram. Pilgrims are meant to strip away material excesses, presenting themselves in a pure and modest form. A fragrance-free shampoo helps pilgrims embrace this simplicity and avoid unnecessary embellishments.
4. Protecting the Sanctity of Ihram
Using any form of fragrance can inadvertently break the sanctity of Ihram. Since the use of scented products is forbidden, fragrance-free shampoo ensures that pilgrims can maintain cleanliness without compromising the sanctity of their pilgrimage.
5. Avoiding Unintentional Violations
Even a small amount of fragrance can lead to unintentional violations of Ihram rules, which may require compensatory acts (such as a penalty). By choosing a fragrance-free shampoo, pilgrims can prevent accidental breaches of Ihram and focus on their prayers and rituals without concern.

products.long_description:
Fruit Knife For Travel with Safety Cover for Hajj & Umrah Pilgrims Preparing for your sacred Hajj or Umrah journey from Bangladesh requires packing smart, reliable, and safe utilities. While traveling through Makkah and Madinah, staying energized with fresh fruits like dates, oranges, and apples is highly essential. Therefore, having a dedicated, travel-friendly cutting tool is incredibly useful for your daily nutrition. This premium Fruit Knife For Travel features a secure safety cover, making it an indispensable, highly practical companion for every pilgrim.
Fruit Knife For Travel Multipurpose use
When packing for international travel, safety remains a top priority. Fortunately, this Fruit Knife For Travel is specifically engineered with a form-fitting, protective wooden sheath. This cover snaps tightly over the blade, completely eliminating the risk of accidental cuts when rummaging through your luggage. As a result, you can safely store it inside your suitcase, backpack, or hotel kitchen drawer with absolute peace of mind.
Premium Craftsmanship Stainless steel
Do not let its portable nature fool you, as this tool is built for exceptional performance. Looking at the specifications, the ultra-sharp stainless steel blade measures approximately 14 cm, while the total length with the handle reaches nearly 20 cm. Furthermore, the blade features a specialized, single-bevel precision edge that slices through tough fruit skins effortlessly. Beautifully paired with a high-quality, ergonomic wooden handle and ornate metallic accents, it offers a secure, slip-resistant grip for comfortable use.
Space-Saving and Perfect for Pilgrim Lodgings
Hotel rooms in Saudi Arabia can often be crowded, and finding proper kitchen utensils is a common challenge. To solve this, this slim, flat-packing Fruit Knife For Travel takes up minimal space in your travel gear. Moreover, the matching wooden cover is designed with a v-shaped notch at the top, allowing the knife to air-dry safely after washing. This smart design keeps your temporary living area organized and safe for your roommates.
A Long-Lasting Companion Beyond the Journey
The utility of this elegant tool extends well beyond your pilgrimage. Specifically, once you return home to Bangladesh, it serves as an excellent, stylish paring knife for your everyday kitchen. Sold as a complete set with its matching safety cover, it is a budget-friendly investment for your travel health. By doing so, it keeps you nourished and energized, thereby letting you focus fully on your prayers and ibadah.

products.long_description:
women hair dry towel
A microfiber hair towel turban is a deceptively simple yet transformative tool in modern hair care. Crafted from ultra-fine synthetic fibers, its soft and densely woven fabric absorbs water far more efficiently than traditional cotton towels—often cutting drying time by up to half—dramatically reducing exposure to heat and preserving hair’s strength. Unlike heavy bath towels, its lightweight turban design features a tapered tip and a secure loop or button, staying comfortably in place so you can go about your routine hands-free. This gentle cocoon minimizes friction on delicate wet strands, helping preserve cuticle integrity and substantially reducing frizz, split ends, and breakage—a benefit that is particularly valuable for fragile, textured, or curly hair types.
women hair dry towel at hajjmart
Microfiber’s superior absorbency also prevents hygral fatigue, which occurs when hair is repeatedly saturated and weakened; this makes the turban especially beneficial for curls, helping them retain their natural pattern, bounce, and definition. It naturally encourages mild scrunching, enhancing curl shape without disturbing the texture. Compact and easy to pack, it’s perfect for travel, gym visits, or busy mornings on the go. Plus, its quick-drying nature supports hygiene and convenience.
Durable and low-maintenance, this towel turban stands up to frequent washing without losing effectiveness; its lint-free fabric resists static and residue, and can be cared for simply with a gentle washing cycle—no fabric softener needed. In short, this hair accessory offers a low-effort, high-impact solution: it speeds up drying, tames frizz, protects delicate strands, supports natural texture, and seamlessly integrates into busy lifestyles. It’s a smart, affordable upgrade that helps maintain healthier, smoother, more manageable hair every day.

কিছু কথা : সমস্ত প্রশংসা মহান আল্লাহ তা’আলারই জন্য, যিনি সমগ্র জগতের প্রতিপালক। একজন মুমিনের মনে সবসময় স্বপ্ন লালিত হয় যে, মহান সৃষ্টিকর্তা আল্লাহর ঘরের পবিত্র স্পর্শ লাভ এবং প্রিয় নবীজীর রওজা শরিফে সালাম জানানোর। একসময় অনেকেরই ডাক আসে আল্লাহর পবিত্র ঘরে ‘লাব্বাইক’ বলে হাজিরা দেওয়ার জন্য।তাই সহীহ্ তরীকায় ‘হজ বা ওমরাহ’ পালন করা প্রত্যেকেরই একান্ত কাম্য। এজন্য ঘর থেকে বের হয়ে আবার ঘরে ফিরে আসা পর্যন্ত সবগুলো অত্যাবশ্যকীয় নিয়ম-নীতি ও কার্যক্রমসমূহ এবং প্রয়োজনীয় দু’আ ও আমলগুলো ধারাবাহিকভাবে এই গাইডে উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে। এর উদ্দেশ্য হলো, যেন আল্লাহর মেহমানরা সহজে ও বিশুদ্ধভাবে, পরিপূর্ণতার সাথে এবং মনের তৃপ্তিতে হজ বা ওমরাহ পালন করতে পারেন।অভিজ্ঞতার আলোকে দেখেছি; নিয়ত, তাওয়াফ, সা’ঈ এবং যিয়ারতের দু’আ-দুরূদ ও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মাসায়েলসমূহ বিভিন্ন বই থেকে খুঁজে বের করে তা জানা বা আমল করা অনেক সময় কঠিন হয়ে পড়ে। তাই যারা হজ বা ওমরাহ এবং মদীনার রওজা পাকের যিয়ারতের ইচ্ছা করেন, আশা করি তাঁরা এই বইখানির দ্বারা অনেক উপকৃত হবেন ইনশা-আল্লাহ্!

products.long_description:
Hajj Dua Book – Complete Guide for Hajj, Umrah & Madina (Bangla Translation)
The Hajj Dua Book is a must-have companion for every pilgrim from Bangladesh preparing for Hajj or Umrah. This small yet powerful guide helps you perform your عبادত (worship) correctly by providing all essential duas in one place. Whether you are a first-time pilgrim or going again, this book makes your spiritual journey easier and more organized.
This Hajj Dua Book is specially designed for Bangladeshi المسلمين (Muslims). It includes Arabic text, Bangla Uccharon (pronunciation), and Bangla meaning, so you can easily read, understand, and recite each dua with confidence. Even if you are not fluent in Arabic, this book ensures you don’t miss any important supplications during your journey.
With 72 pages of carefully selected content, this book covers all the essential duas for Hajj, Umrah, and visits to Madina. From Ihram to Tawaf, Sa’i, Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah, and Ziyarah – every important step is included. You don’t need to carry multiple books anymore; everything is compiled in one compact guide.
The portable size (5 inch x 4 inch) makes it extremely easy to carry. It fits perfectly in your pocket, bag, or Ihram belt, making it convenient for use anytime during your यात्रा (journey). Whether you are walking in Tawaf or resting in Mina, you can quickly access your duas without hassle.
One of the most useful features of this Hajj Dua Book is the neck band rope. You can hang it around your neck for easy access while performing rituals. This reduces the risk of losing the book in crowded places like Masjid al-Haram or Jamarat. It also allows hands-free reading, which is very helpful during Tawaf and Sa’i.
Key Features of Hajj Dua Book:

Complete Hajj Dua Book for Hajj, Umrah & Madina
Includes Arabic, Bangla Uccharon & Bangla Meaning
Total 72 pages of essential duas
Compact size (5” x 4”) – easy to carry
Neck band rope for convenient reading
Ideal for Bangladeshi pilgrims

This Hajj Dua Book is not just a book; it is your spiritual guide throughout the journey. It helps you stay focused, organized, and connected to Allah during every step of Hajj and Umrah.

Hajj Ihram belt
Ihram Belt For Hajj and umrah
Waist Pack bag
4 pocket
Wayerproof
Color : Black. White
Tie for Ihram cloth
If you are planning to perform Hajj or Umrah, there are several essential items that you will need to bring with you. Here are some of the most important items:

Ihram clothing: Two pieces of white, seamless cloth that cover the body, one for the upper body and the other for the lower body. It is worn by men and women during Hajj and Umrah.
Money belt: A secure waist pouch or bag that you can wear under your clothing to keep your money, passport, and other important documents safe.
Comfortable walking shoes: As Hajj and Umrah involve a lot of walking, it is essential to bring comfortable and sturdy shoes.
Toiletries: Bring a small bag with items such as soap, shampoo, toothbrush, and toothpaste, as well as any other personal care items you may need.
Prayer mat: A small prayer mat to use during prayer times.
Water bottle: Bring a refillable water bottle to stay hydrated during the journey.
Umbrella or hat: To protect yourself from the sun and heat.
First aid kit: Basic medical supplies such as pain relievers, bandages, and antiseptic cream can be helpful.
Mobile phone and charger: To stay in touch with your loved ones and for emergency purposes.

It’s important to note that there may be additional items required or recommended based on your specific needs or the requirements of your travel agency or tour group. Be sure to check with them before you leave.

A best idea to gift you your friends, colleague who are hajj pilgrimage. All of them are very useful for hajj & umrah.
This hajj kit contains natural products.
Hajj kit contains unscented items

Hajj Soap
Meswake
Shampoo-100 mL
Moisturizing oi 100 mL
7 pointTasbi

Unscented Hajj Soap
Gentle on the skin: The soap is often made with natural ingredients that are gentle and soothing, suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. This is important as pilgrims may experience dryness or irritation due to the arid climate and the physical demands of the journey.

Some versions of Hajj soap may have multipurpose uses, serving not only as a body cleanser but also as a shampoo or laundry detergent. This versatility can be particularly useful for pilgrims who need to travel light and minimize the number of items they carry.

Overall, Hajj soap plays an important role in promoting hygiene and well-being among pilgrims during the sacred journey of Hajj. By choosing the right soap that meets their needs and preferences, pilgrims can maintain cleanliness and focus on the spiritual aspects of their pilgrimage experience.
Jaitoon Meswake
Miswak: Miswak is a teeth-cleaning twig made from the Salvadora persica tree. It has been used for centuries in various cultures as a natural alternative to toothbrushes and toothpaste. Miswak It’s important to note that while natural ingredients like olive oil and miswak can complement oral hygiene practices, regular brushing with fluoride toothpaste and flossing remain essential components of a comprehensive oral care routine. Additionally, individuals with specific dental concerns should consult with a dentist for personalized recommendations and treatment optition

Full Coverage: The Ladies’ Nikab Sun Cap offers full coverage for the face and neck, including a built-in nikab that extends to cover the lower portion of the face. It allows you to adhere to the modesty requirements of Hajj while protecting your skin from the sun’s harmful rays.

Adjustable and Secure Fit: The cap features an adjustable strap at the back, allowing you to customize the fit according to your preference. This ensures a secure and snug fit, allowing you to move with ease during your spiritual journey.
Versatility and Convenience: The Ladies’ Nikab Sun Cap is versatile and can be easily folded and packed, making it a convenient travel companion. It retains its shape even after being folded, making it durable for repeated use.
Stylish Design: This cap blends functionality with style, offering an elegant and fashionable appearance. It comes in a range of colors and designs, allowing you to express your personal taste while maintaining modesty.

Embark on your Hajj pilgrimage with peace of mind, knowing that you have a dedicated solution that combines the benefits of a sun cap and nikab. The Ladies’ Nikab Sun Cap ensures that you can focus on your spiritual journey while staying protected and comfortable throughout.

products.long_description:
Ensure peace of mind during your sacred journey with the Hajj & Umrah Anti-Theft Neck Bag and Side Bag, thoughtfully designed to keep your essentials safe, organized, and easily accessible throughout your pilgrimage. Whether you are performing Tawaf, Sa’i, or traveling between holy sites, this compact yet spacious bag is an ideal companion for every pilgrim.
Hajj & Umrah Anti-Theft Neck Bag and Side Bag – Secure, Comfortable & Practical for Pilgrims
Made from high-quality canvas fabric, this bag is durable, lightweight, and comfortable for long hours of use. Canvas is well known for its strength and breathability, making it suitable for the hot climate of Makkah and Madinah. The sturdy material also helps protect your valuables from daily wear and tear during travel and rituals.
With a practical size of 10 inch x 8 inch, the bag offers ample space without feeling bulky. It features three separate chambers, allowing you to organize your belongings efficiently. You can securely store your passport, mobile phone, money, ATM cards, hotel key, Tasbeeh, and other important items in separate compartments, reducing the risk of loss or confusion.
The anti-theft design ensures added security in crowded areas such as the Haram, airports, and public transport. Worn as a neck bag or side bag, it keeps your valuables close to your body, minimizing the chance of pickpocketing. The secure zippers and smart compartment layout help protect your belongings while allowing quick access whenever needed.
This bag is available in three elegant and practical colors: White, Olive, and Brown. The white color perfectly matches Ihram clothing, while olive and brown offer a classic, versatile look suitable for both Hajj and Umrah as well as everyday travel. The neutral color options make it suitable for men and women of all ages.
Designed with comfort in mind, the adjustable strap allows you to wear the bag around your neck or across your body according to your preference. Its lightweight construction ensures it does not cause discomfort, even when worn for extended periods.
The Hajj & Umrah Anti-Theft Neck Bag and Side Bag is not just a travel accessory—it is a reliable solution for safe, organized, and stress-free pilgrimage. An essential item for every pilgrim seeking security, convenience, and comfort during their spiritual journey.

products.long_description:
Performing Hajj or Umrah requires enduring harsh climates and long hours in Ihram. Our Hajj & Umrah Moisturizing Oil is specifically crafted to provide intense hydration and skin protection throughout your spiritual journey. In a convenient 100ml bottle, it’s easy to carry and compliant with travel regulations.
This lightweight, non-greasy formula absorbs quickly, keeping your skin soft and moisturized without leaving a residue. The fragrance-free formulation adheres to Ihram requirements, allowing you to focus on your rituals without worry. Ideal for dry or sensitive skin, this oil ensures protection from dehydration caused by the intense heat, long walking hours, and exposure to dust.

Size: 100ml (portable, travel-friendly)
Ihram-Friendly: 100% fragrance-free
Non-greasy, fast-absorbing formula
Protects skin from dryness and harsh conditions
Suitable for all skin types

Ensure your skin stays smooth and hydrated with Hajj & Umrah Moisturizing Oil, designed to offer comfort and care during your pilgrimage.
To effectively combat dry skin and stay hydrated during Hajj with moisturizing oil, follow these steps:
1. Apply Hajj Umrah Moisturizing Oil Regularly

Before Ihram: Apply a light layer of moisturizing oil after showering to lock in moisture.
During Hajj: Reapply throughout the day, especially after washing or when your skin feels dry, to protect against the desert heat.
Post-Ritual Care: After completing the day’s rituals, cleanse your skin and reapply the oil to keep it hydrated overnight.

2. Focus on Key Areas

Pay extra attention to areas prone to dryness, such as your face, hands, elbows, and feet. The feet, in particular, endure long walking hours and require consistent moisture to avoid cracking.

3. Stay Hydrated

Drink plenty of water alongside using moisturizing oil. Internal hydration is essential for maintaining skin moisture during Hajj.

4. Use a Fragrance-Free Oil soap

Ensure that the moisturizing oil is Ihram-compliant (fragrance-free) to avoid any violations of Ihram rules while keeping your skin nourished.

5. Apply Oil After Washing

Use the oil immediately after washing your hands or face to seal in moisture. The quick absorption of the oil will prevent your skin from drying out in the hot weather.

hand gloves 100 pcs pack is an essential item for every Hajj and Umrah pilgrim. During Hajj, you stay in crowded places, travel a lot, and touch many surfaces. These disposable gloves help you stay clean, safe, and comfortable throughout your journey.
These gloves are made from lightweight and transparent plastic material. They are soft, flexible, and easy to wear. You can quickly put them on and remove them without any hassle. The gloves fit most hand sizes, making them perfect for both pilgrims
The hand gloves 100 pcs pack is very useful for maintaining hygiene. You can use them while eating, handling luggage, using public transport, or visiting crowded areas like Mina, Arafat, and Muzdalifah. They create a protective layer between your hands and dirt, helping reduce the risk of germs.
These gloves are also ideal for personal care tasks. You can use them when applying oil, cream, or other fragrance-free products during Ihram. Since cleanliness is very important in Islam, these gloves help you follow hygiene rules easily during your spiritual journey.
Another great benefit of the hand gloves 100 pcs pack is convenience. The pack contains enough gloves for multiple uses, so you don’t need to worry about running out during your trip. They are lightweight and easy to carry in your bag, pocket, or luggage.
These disposable gloves are also suitable for daily use beyond Hajj and Umrah. You can use them for travel, food handling, cleaning, or any situation where hygiene matters.

Best Head Umbrella for Hajj and Umrah – Stay Cool and Protected
Performing Hajj and Umrah is a spiritual journey that requires physical endurance, especially under the intense heat of Makkah. Pilgrims walk long distances between sacred sites, making sun protection essential. A Head Umbrella for Hajj Umrah is the perfect solution to shield yourself from the sun while keeping your hands free.
Why You Need a Head Umbrella for Hajj and Umrah
Many pilgrims experience exhaustion due to high temperatures, which can lead to dehydration and heatstroke. A head umbrella offers full sun protection, keeping your head, face, and shoulders cool while you perform rituals like Tawaf and Sa’i without any hassle.
Top Features of a Head Umbrella for Pilgrims
When choosing a Head Umbrella for Hajj and Umrah, look for these key features:✅ Lightweight & Comfortable – Designed for long hours of wear without discomfort.✅ Hands-Free Design – Allows free movement during prayers and rituals.✅ UV Protection & Heat Resistance – Blocks harmful sun rays, reducing sunburn risk.✅ Adjustable & Secure Fit – Elastic or strap-based fastening for different head sizes.✅ Foldable & Portable – Easy to pack and carry in your Hajj or Umrah travel kit.
Where to Buy the Best Head Umbrella for Hajj Umrah?
If you are preparing for your pilgrimage, investing in a high-quality Head Umbrella for Hajj Umrah is essential for a comfortable and safe journey. Check out our collection at Hajj Mart and ensure maximum sun protection during your sacred trip.

Best Inflatable Travel Pillow for a Comfortable Hajj Journey

Performing Hajj is a physically demanding spiritual journey that requires long hours of travel, waiting, and resting in different conditions. A high-quality inflatable travel pillow made of TPU material can be an essential companion to ensure comfort and proper neck support during the pilgrimage.
Why You Need a Travel Pillow for Hajj
During Hajj, you may need to rest while traveling by bus, plane, or train. Even in tents at Mina, Muzdalifah, and Arafat, proper neck support can help prevent fatigue and stiffness. A portable, inflatable pillow ensures you can rest comfortably wherever you are.
Benefits of a TPU Inflatable Pillow for Hajj
✔ Soft & Skin-Friendly – Made from high-elasticity TPU, this pillow is more comfortable and durable than traditional materials, making it ideal for long hours of rest.✔ Ergonomic Neck Support – Prevents neck strain and provides proper spinal alignment, reducing discomfort after long hours of travel.✔ Compact & Lightweight – Easily fits in your bag and inflates within seconds using a hand-press system—no need to blow air manually.✔ Water & Sweat Resistant – Designed to withstand hot and humid weather, ensuring a clean and hygienic experience.✔ Multipurpose Use – Perfect for use in planes, buses, Muzdalifah overnight stays, and even tents in Mina.
A Must-Have for Your Hajj Packing List
This inflatable pillow is a small but valuable addition to your Hajj essentials. It ensures proper rest, reducing fatigue so you can focus on your spiritual journey.
Get Your Travel Pillow for Hajj Today!
Don’t let discomfort affect your Hajj experience. Invest in a high-quality inflatable travel pillow and enjoy better sleep wherever you are.

products.long_description:
Insulin Cooler Travel Case
Portable Insulin Cooler Travel Case
This small insulated insulin bag is designed to keep your medicine safe and cool during travel. The package includes one compact insulin cooling case and two reusable ice packs. The bag size is 8.46″ x 3.54″ x 2.28″, making it easy to carry inside a backpack or handbag without taking up much space. It is made from high-quality PU leather and durable Oxford cloth, and it weighs only 270 grams including the ice packs. This makes it lightweight and perfect for travel.
One of the best features of this insulin case is the built-in temperature display. You can easily check the internal temperature anytime to make sure your insulin stays within a safe range. This helps protect your medicine from damage due to heat.
The bag is designed with multiple layers for strong insulation. The inner aluminum foil lining helps maintain temperature and also provides waterproof protection. Whether you need to keep items cool or slightly warm, this bag can maintain the temperature for several hours. When used with ice packs, it helps keep insulin cool and effective.
The package includes two reusable ice packs made from safe, non-toxic, and latex-free materials. For best results, place the ice packs in the freezer for 8–10 hours before use. Once frozen, they can keep the contents cool for about 4–6 hours, making them ideal for travel and daily use.
Even though the bag is small, it is very practical. It has multiple compartments to store insulin pens, needles, cotton pads, sensor patches, and other small medical items. Everything stays organized and easy to access.
This compact insulin cooling bag is a smart and reliable choice for anyone who needs to carry insulin safely while traveling.

products.long_description:
The iQIBLA Zikr Ring is a revolutionary smart tasbih designed to seamlessly integrate spiritual practice with modern technology. This innovative wearable allows Muslims to effortlessly track their daily zikr (remembrance of Allah) and receive timely prayer reminders, empowering a more consistent and mindful spiritual journey.
At its core, the Zikr Ring features a discreet yet vibrant 0.49″ OLED display that shows your real-time tasbih count, the current time, and critical prayer alerts. With an integrated CNC button, keeping track of your recitations is intuitive and precise. The ring even vibrates subtly at set intervals (e.g., 33, 66, 99, or 100 counts) as a gentle reminder to continue your zikr.
Beyond its counting capabilities, the iQIBLA Zikr Ring boasts Bluetooth 5.1 connectivity, enabling it to sync effortlessly with the iQIBLA app on your smartphone (Android and iOS compatible). This app serves as a comprehensive spiritual companion, allowing you to track your daily zikr progress, monitor prayer timings, and even set personalized zikr goals and reminders.
Crafted from high-quality, durable materials, the Zikr Ring is lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear. Many models feature an IP68 waterproof rating, ensuring peace of mind during wudu and in various weather conditions. Powered by a long-lasting battery, typically offering several days of usage on a single charge, it conveniently recharges via a portable magnetic USB charging case or cable.
Available in various sizes and finishes, the iQIBLA Zikr Ring is more than just a gadget; it’s a bridge between tradition and technology, making spiritual practices more accessible and engaging in the contemporary world.

Can be used for both kids & adult. 2.5 meter anti lost lock belt. 360 degree rotating feature

Kids Anti-Lost Lock Belt (2.5 Meter)Keep your little ones safe and close with the Kids Anti-Lost Lock Belt, designed to give parents peace of mind while allowing children the freedom to explore. This 2.5-meter safety harness is perfect for outdoor trips, crowded places, and busy environments, ensuring your child stays within a safe distance.
Key Features: Kids Anti Lost Belt

2.5 Meter Stretchable Cord: The belt extends up to 2.5 meters, giving your child freedom to move while keeping them within a safe distance.
Comfortable Wristbands: Soft, adjustable wrist straps ensure a snug fit for both the child and the parent, preventing discomfort during long use.
Durable Locking System: Equipped with a secure locking mechanism that prevents accidental release, offering additional security in crowded areas.
360° Rotating Design: The 360° swivel connector allows smooth movement, preventing tangling as your child moves around freely.
Anti-Loss Safety: Perfect for keeping your child close in busy environments like markets, airports, parks, or shopping malls.
Durable & Lightweight: Made from high-quality, durable materials that are lightweight and easy to carry, ensuring long-term use without compromising comfort.

Ideal For:

Parents with toddlers and young children.
Traveling families who need extra security in busy areas.
Outdoor activities such as trips to parks, malls, or public events.

products.long_description:
Luggage Sticker BD
Luggage Sticker BD for Hajj or Umrah Pilgrims – Essential for Safe Travel
Traveling for Hajj or Umrah is a once-in-a-lifetime journey, and ensuring your belongings are safe and easily identifiable is crucial. The Luggage Sticker BD is a must-have for Bangladeshi pilgrims traveling to Saudi Arabia. This sticker helps in quick identification of luggage, preventing loss or confusion in crowded airports, hotels, and transportation areas.
This Hajj or Umrah luggage sticker features the Bangladesh flag and the country’s name in both English and Arabic, making it easier for authorities, fellow pilgrims, and transport staff to recognize your baggage. It includes dedicated spaces for writing essential traveler details such as name, passport number, address, hotel name, and mobile number. These details are crucial in case of lost or misplaced luggage, helping authorities return it to the rightful owner.
The Luggage Sticker BD is designed with durable, high-quality material, ensuring it stays intact despite rough handling during travel. The adhesive is strong enough to stick firmly to suitcases, bags, and other luggage items, yet it can be removed without leaving residue. Pilgrims carrying multiple bags can use these stickers on each piece for added security and peace of mind.
For Hajj and Umrah pilgrims, organization and security are key to a smooth journey. The Luggage Sticker BD minimizes stress by ensuring your belongings are marked and protected. Available at Hajj Mart, this sticker is an essential travel accessory for every Bangladeshi pilgrim heading to Makkah and Madinah. Get yours today and travel with confidence!

Whether you are performing Hajj or Umrah, this kit provides everything from high-grade Ihram garments to specialized fragrance-free hygiene products.
Premium Male Hajj Package
We believe that quality is paramount during this once-in-a-lifetime journey. Every item in this list has been selected for its durability and practical utility in the demanding climate of the Holy Cities. One of the unique features of our service is full flexibility—you have the freedom to add, remove, or swap items to suit your specific needs. Capsule Umbrella: This Umrah Product Package includes a white capsule umbrella with nice box. It is easy to carry in bag. Folded size is 8 inch.

Draw String Bag:: A draw string bag is required for umrah trip. Rope is thick type and waterproof fabric has been used. Two color black and white are available.
Shoe Bag: Shoe bag is very important accessories for a umrah pilgrim. You need to carry shoe bag when you enter haram or kaaba sharif.
7 point tasbe: Counter tasbee is required for tawaf and saiee counter. This is useful craft for umrah pilgrims.
Buker bag: All necessary documents are kept on chest bag.

Dua booklet: This dua booklet includs all important dua for umrah. A rope is attached to draw from neck.
Meswake: A meswake is important part for cleaning tooth
Fragnance free soap: in state of ihram use of any fragrance prohibited. You can use fragnance free soap. Hajj soap is totally natural and pillgrims can use it in face, hand and body wash.
Tayammum mati: You need to take ozu at air. Some times there is shortage of water in airline. So doing tayammum is very important this times.

products.long_description:
Men Headscarf Shemagh (Keffiyeh) – Available in Bangladesh The Arab Headscarf Shemagh, also known as the Keffiyeh, is a versatile and traditional piece of clothing that blends cultural heritage with practical use. Made from soft, breathable cotton, this headscarf is designed to protect you from the harsh sun, wind, and dust, making it ideal for Bangladesh’s diverse climate. Whether you’re heading to the mosque, traveling for Hajj or Umrah, or simply looking to add a stylish touch to your outfit, the Shemagh is the perfect accessory.
Key Features:

Premium Quality Material: Made from high-quality cotton or a cotton-polyester blend, offering comfort and durability.
Authentic Design: Available in traditional red & white or black & white patterns, reflecting the original Arab design.
Multi-purpose: Can be worn as a headscarf, neck scarf, or even a shawl, providing versatility for different occasions.

Nail Cutting Kit ideal for hajj umrah travel
Maintain clean, healthy, and well-groomed nails wherever you go with this premium Nail Cutting Kit Box. this all-in-one manicure and pedicure set includes essential tools for nail care, facial grooming, and personal hygiene. Whether you are at home, traveling, or gifting someone special, this stylish grooming kit offers convenience, durability, and elegance in one compact box.
Nail Cutting Kit Box – Complete Grooming Solution in One Compact Case
The Nail Cutting Kit Box comes in a modern, minimal hard case that keeps all tools neatly organized and protected. Its slim and lightweight design makes it easy to carry in your bag, suitcase, or drawer. The secure closure ensures that tools stay in place, preventing damage or loss during travel.
Inside the kit, you will find a complete set of high-quality grooming tools crafted from durable stainless steel. These tools are rust-resistant, sharp, and easy to clean, ensuring long-term use and hygienic grooming. The kit includes large nail clippers, diagonal nail clippers, flat mouth nail clippers, a glass nail file, ear spoon, dead skin pusher, nose hair clipper, and scissors. Each tool is ergonomically designed for comfortable handling and precise trimming.
This Nail Cutter Kit is ideal for maintaining fingernails, toenails, cuticles, ear care, and nose hair trimming. The sharp blades provide smooth and clean cuts without pulling or damaging the nails. The glass nail file helps shape nails gently, while the dead skin pusher keeps cuticles neat and healthy.
Perfect for daily grooming, this kit is suitable for professionals, travelers, and anyone who values personal care. Its elegant look also makes it a great gift choice for birthdays, Eid, weddings, Hajj and Umrah travelers, or corporate gifting.
hajj umrah cosmetics
In addition to functionality, the Nail Cutting Kit Box offers excellent value by combining multiple grooming tools in one organized case. You no longer need to buy separate tools or worry about misplacing them. Everything you need for complete nail and personal grooming is right at your fingertips.
If you are looking for a reliable, stylish, and practical grooming solution, this Nail box Cutting Kit is the perfect choice. Invest in proper self-care and enjoy salon-like grooming results anytime, anywhere.

products.long_description:
Portable Hanger Travel Size for Hajj & Umrah Pilgrims. Preparing for Hajj and Umrah from Bangladesh requires the right travel gear. For instance, managing shared room space in the busy hotels of Makkah and Madinah can be quite difficult. Therefore, keeping your Ihram clothes, prayer mats, and waist bags organized is essential for your peace of mind. Fortunately, this travel-friendly Fortable Hanger is a brilliant, space-saving utility designed to keep your living space orderly, clean, and highly efficient.
Portable Hanger Instant, Damage-Free Hanging in Hotel Rooms
Finding enough wardrobe space or wall hooks in pilgrim hotels is a common challenge. To solve this, this innovative Fortable Hanger features a strong, self-adhesive sticker at the back. As a result, it allows you to instantly mount a hook on tiles, wooden doors, or inside cabinets. Moreover, you do not need nails or drills, so you will not damage hotel property. Simply peel, stick, and create an instant hanging station anywhere. Consequently, this ensures your sacred garments never touch the floor.
360-Degree Rotation for Effortless Use
Engineered for maximum convenience, this multi-functional organizer features a smooth, 360-degree rotatable design. In addition, you can mount it vertically under shelves or horizontally on flat walls. Indeed, this flexibility adapts beautifully to compact travel lodgings. The rotating prongs allow you to quickly grab your towels, tasbih, or identity badges. Consequently, it saves valuable time when rushing to catch the shuttle bus for congregational prayers at the Haram.
Do not let its lightweight, travel-friendly size fool you. In fact, crafted from high-quality, premium plastic, this durable Fortable Hanger comfortably supports up to 3 kg of weight. Furthermore, it is robust enough to hold wet towels, heavy waist bags, or multiple garments simultaneously. Additionally, the hook is completely detachable. Thus, it packs completely flat in your suitcase and is incredibly easy to clean between uses.
Versatile Home Organization After Your Journey
The utility of this smart tool extends well beyond your pilgrimage. Specifically, once you return home to Bangladesh, it serves as an excellent organizer for your house. For example, you can use it to tidy up kitchen utensils, keys, or bathroom accessories. Sold as a single piece, this compact Fortable Hanger is an indispensable, budget-friendly companion. By doing so, it keeps your daily essentials neatly arranged and within arm’s reach, thereby saving you time and letting you focus fully on your prayers.

products.long_description:
Ameer Al Oud Attar BD – Premium Long-Lasting Alcohol-Free Arabian Fragrance
Ameer Al Oud Attar is a luxurious, majestic fragrance inspired by the rich and royal perfume heritage of Saudi Arabia. Capturing the true essence of traditional Middle Eastern luxury, this premium attar is an exceptional addition for anyone who appreciates deep, warm, and sophisticated oriental scents. Crafted as a highly concentrated perfume oil, its formula ensures elite, long-lasting performance that stays vibrant throughout the day.
Unlike ordinary perfumes, Ameer Al Oud Attar is $100\%$ alcohol-free. This makes it a highly preferred choice for those seeking a traditional, authentic Arabian fragrance experience. The rich oil base bonds beautifully with skin and clothing fabrics, releasing a deeper, more premium aroma that outperforms standard sprays.
The Fragrance Profile of Ameer Al Oud
The fragrance opens with a rich, commanding Oud character blended with a subtle hint of warm sweetness that creates an immediate, unforgettable impression. As the day progresses, its deep woody notes develop beautifully, resulting in a warm, elegant, and sophisticated aroma. The result is a refined scent that remains noticeably distinct and captivating without ever being overpowering.
Whether you are preparing for Hajj and Umrah, attending Friday Jummah prayers, going to the office, or celebrating special family occasions, Ameer Al Oud adapts effortlessly. Its versatile and balanced profile appeals beautifully to all genders, making it an incredibly thoughtful and prestigious gift for loved ones who cherish authentic Arabian perfumery.
Key Features & Practical Benefits

Authentic Ameer Al Oud Blend: A rich, royal combination of deep woody oud, warm sweetness, and oriental notes.

$100\%$ Alcohol-Free Oil: Pure concentrated perfume oil that is completely halaal and safe for the skin.

Long-Lasting Performance: Exceptional staying power on skin and clothes due to its non-evaporating oil base.

Travel-Friendly Bottle: A compact, pocket-sized design that easily fits into your pocket, panjabi, or grooming kit for convenient application anywhere.

Economical & High Value: Highly concentrated—just a few drops applied to your pulse points provide hours of luxury, meaning one bottle lasts much longer than ordinary perfumes.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: Is Ameer Al Oud Attar suitable for daily use in Bangladesh?
A: Yes, absolutely. Because it is completely alcohol-free and long-lasting, it has become a highly trusted choice for daily wear, office environments, and hot weather conditions where standard perfumes fade quickly.
Q: How should I apply Ameer Al Oud for the best results?
A: Apply a few drops directly onto your pulse points, such as your wrists, inner elbows, and behind the ears. To apply to clothes, rub a drop between your palms first and gently sweep your hands across your clothing to ensure an even distribution without staining.

Indulge in the golden sweetness of our Premium Sukkari Dates and discover why they are a favorite among date lovers worldwide. Taste the difference that true quality makes.

If you are planning to perform Hajj or Umrah, there are several essential items that you will need to bring with you. Here are some of the most important items:

Ihram clothing: Two pieces of white, seamless cloth that cover the body, one for the upper body and the other for the lower body. It is worn by men and women during Hajj and Umrah.
Money belt: A secure waist pouch or bag that you can wear under your clothing to keep your money, passport, and other important documents safe.
Comfortable walking shoes: As Hajj and Umrah involve a lot of walking, it is essential to bring comfortable and sturdy shoes.
Toiletries: Bring a small bag with items such as soap, shampoo, toothbrush, and toothpaste, as well as any other personal care items you may need.
Prayer mat: A small prayer mat to use during prayer times.
Water bottle: Bring a refillable water bottle to stay hydrated during the journey.
Umbrella or hat: To protect yourself from the sun and heat.
First aid kit: Basic medical supplies such as pain relievers, bandages, and antiseptic cream can be helpful.
Mobile phone and charger: To stay in touch with your loved ones and for emergency purposes.

It’s important to note that there may be additional items required or recommended based on your specific needs or the requirements of your travel agency or tour group. Be sure to check with them before you leave.

products.price_text: ৳ 250 Original price was: ৳ 250. ৳ 200 Current price is: ৳ 200.
products.short_description:
এই মোজা শুধু হজ্জ ও ওমরাহ সফরকারী তাওয়াফ ও সাঈ করার জন্য তৈরী করা হয়েছে। আর্টিফিসিয়াল লেদার এবং ইলাস্টিক হওয়ার কারনে তাওয়াফকারীর টাইলসের উপর ২-৩ কিলোমিটার হাটতে অনেক আরামদায়ক হয় এবং পুরুষেরা নফল তাওয়াফ ও কাবাঘরে যাতায়াতে নামাজে এটি ব্যবহার করেন। তাই সাধারণ ব্যবহারকারীদের অর্ডার না করার অনুরোধ রইল। শুধু মাত্র হজ্জ এবং ওমরাহ যাত্রীদের অর্ডার করার পরামর্শ দেওয়া হলো।

অনেকেই অরিজিনাল চামড়া মনে করে এবং দাম কম দেখে অর্ডার করে এবং আমরা আর্থিক ক্ষতিগ্রস্থ হয়।

Tawaf Socks
Material: Artificial leather
Anti slippery leather
Comfortable for tawaf and saiee
Size: M(Sandle size 35-40), L(Sandle size41-45)

Note: Female pilgrims wear during ihram but Male can not use during ihram but can use during nofol tawaf, saiee & other times

Quality Craftsmanship: We understand the significance of this spiritual practice, which is why our Tawaf 7-Point Tasbeeh is crafted with meticulous attention to detail. Each bead is carefully handcrafted using high-quality materials, ensuring durability and longevity. With seven distinct and easily distinguishable beads, you can effortlessly keep track of each circumambulation. Symbolic Significance: The Tawaf 7-Point Tasbeeh holds deep symbolic significance, representing your commitment and devotion to the Tawaf ritual. Each bead represents a round performed around the Kaaba, strengthening your spiritual connection and reminding you of the profound significance of this sacred practice. Immerse yourself in the spiritual essence of each circumambulation and deepen your connection with the Divine. products.long_description:
Toilet Seat Cover bd Stay Clean and Confident with Our Disposable Toilet Seat Cover!
Are you constantly worried about using public toilets in Bangladesh? The sight of urine stains, shoe prints, and invisible germs on commodes is unsettling. Say goodbye to these worries with our premium Disposable Toilet Seat Cover. It’s the ultimate solution for maintaining hygiene for you and your family, wherever you go, putting an end to your public toilet anxieties.
Complete Hygienic Protection Toilet Seat Cover
Our disposable Toilet commoode cover Seat Cover creates a perfect protective barrier, insulating your skin from direct contact with unsanitary toilet seats. Designed with anti-bacterium properties, it ensures a safe and clean experience every time. You no longer have to hover awkwardly over the toilet or waste tissues trying to wipe it down. It provides essential peace of mind, especially for your children, protecting them from germs in public restrooms at shopping malls, offices, hospitals, and stations.
Flushable & Clog-Free Convenience
The most revolutionary feature? It dissolves completely in water! After use, simply flush it away. This innovative paper material dissolves quickly, so you can throw it straight into the toilet without any fear of causing clogs or blockages. This makes disposal incredibly discreet and hassle-free, a feature you’ll appreciate in any public facility.
Perfect for Everyone, Everywhere
Each pack is compact and lightweight (only 30g), making it a handy pocket-sized essential. Easily slip it into your purse, backpack, or pocket. It’s perfect for travelling, commuting, camping, or daily use. With a universal size of 43×35.5 cm, our Toilet Seat Cover is thoughtfully designed to fit all standard toilet seats, making it suitable and safe for both adults and kids.
Each pack contains 10 easy-to-use covers. Don’t let unhygienic public toilets hold you back. Order your pack of Disposable Bathroom Cover tissue today and ensure complete hygiene for your entire family!

products.long_description:
Prepare for your sacred pilgrimage with our Towel Ihram Cloth BD, crafted for both comfort and purity. This high-quality, 100% cotton towel Ihram ensures softness and breathability, keeping you cool and comfortable during your spiritual journey. Designed to meet the requirements of Ihram for Hajj and Umrah, it is lightweight, absorbent, and easy to wear.
Towel Ihram Cloth BD – Premium Quality for Hajj & Umrah
Whether you’re heading for Hajj or Umrah, this Towel Ihram Cloth BD offers the perfect balance of tradition and practicality. Available in different sizes, this Ihram towel is easy to maintain and ideal for travelers from Bangladesh and beyond. Durable and designed for repeated use, it is an essential item for every pilgrim.

Made from premium cotton for maximum comfort
Lightweight and easy to pack for travel
Soft, breathable, and skin-friendly
Compliant with Islamic rituals for Ihram

Ensure your pilgrimage is comfortable and hassle-free with the Towel Ihram Cloth BD – your trusted companion for Hajj and Umrah.
tep-by-Step Guide to Wearing Ihram Cloth:
1. Cleanse Yourself:

Before donning the Ihram, perform Ghusl (full-body purification) or take a regular shower.
Trim your nails, shave any excess body hair, and put on light, unscented oil if desired. Wearing unscented deodorant is also allowed.

2. Wear the Lower Garment (Izar):

Wrap the lower cloth (Izar) around your waist, covering the body from just above the navel to the ankles.
The cloth should be secure and tight enough so that it doesn’t fall, yet comfortable for walking. You can use a simple knot or a belt to secure it around your waist.
Ensure the lower garment covers your navel and extends below your ankles, while being loose enough for ease of movement.

3. Wear the Upper Garment (Rida):

Drape the upper cloth (Rida) over your shoulders. One end should hang over your left shoulder while the other wraps around your body.
You can leave your right shoulder uncovered (known as Iztiba) during the Tawaf al-Qudum (the arrival circumambulation at the Kaaba).
After Tawaf, cover both shoulders by wrapping the Rida fully around the upper body.

4. Footwear:

Wear simple sandals that leave your ankles and the tops of your feet exposed. Make sure they comply with the rules of Ihram.

products.long_description:
Modern Minimalist Infuser Sport Bottle — 750 ml
This sleek, round 750 ml sport bottle is crafted from BPA‑free polycarbonate (PC), delivering a durable yet lightweight feel that’s perfect for everyday hydration. Measuring approximately 21–25 cm in height with an 8 cm diameter, it offers generous capacity while remaining easy to carry—ideal for gym sessions, commutes, office use, or outdoor adventures.
The bottle features a one-click flip-top lid with a secure locking mechanism and an integrated carry handle, enabling easy one-handed operation and leak-free transport. Its single-layer construction and plain, neutral-toned design embrace modern-minimalist aesthetics while promoting environmental sustainability through reusability.
A built-in removable strainer sitting just under the lid makes it easy to infuse water with fruits or tea, while keeping out pulp and seeds for a smooth drinking experience. Clear volume markers on the body help you conveniently track your daily water intake. The wide mouth design simplifies filling and cleaning—whether hand-washed or placed on the top rack of a dishwasher. Note: this bottle isn’t microwave-safe.
Made from non-toxic, food-safe materials, this bottle is suitable for general use by anyone—students, professionals, athletes. The direct-drink spout supports fast, fuss-free hydration without requiring extra straws. Its minimalist appearance and neutral color palette complement any style, while the sturdy PC construction ensures long-lasting use and supports eco-conscious living. This bottle blends form and function, making it a stylish, practical companion for staying hydrated throughout the day.

products.long_description:
Travel Digital Weight Scale Portable Size – Perfect for Travelers in Bangladesh
Looking for a compact, reliable travel scale to avoid overweight baggage fees? Meet the Travel Digital Weight Scale Portable Size – a lightweight, pocket-sized solution tailored for Bangladeshi travellers.
Crafted with convenience and accuracy in mind, this portable luggage scale offers:

High Accuracy & 50 kg Capacity: Built with precision strain gauge technology, it measures up to 50 kg/110 lb with ±0.1 kg accuracy, ensuring exact weight readings every time.

Portable & Ultra-Lightweight: Weighing just around 90 g and measuring only 150 × 30 × 40 mm, it easily slips into a pocket, carry‑on, or pouch.

User-Friendly LCD Display: A large blue-backlit screen displays weight in real time, even in dim light—perfect for busy airport counters.

Multiple Weight Units & Tare Function: Switch between kg, lb, oz, or jin with the press of a button. The tare feature deducts container weight, giving you precise net weight readings.

Durable Construction: Built with rugged ABS plastic housing and a stainless‑steel hook, featuring a sturdy T‑handle grip designed to reduce hand strain—even with hefty luggage.

Smart Power Management: Powered by a long-lasting CR2032 battery (included), with automatic shut-off after two minutes to conserve energy.

Why This Portable Scale Is Ideal for Bangladesh:
Whether flying out from Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, or Rajshahi, this travel scale helps you avoid excess baggage fees at both domestic and international airports. It’s also great for weighing parcels, packages, or household items. With its slim design and reliable accuracy, the Travel Digital Weight Scale Portable Size is a must-have travel tool.

Are you looking for a reliable, stylish, and durable bag that can keep up with your active lifestyle in Bangladesh? Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway to Sylhet, heading to the gym after work in Dhaka, or packing for a short trip back to your village, our classic olive green Travel Duffel Bag is designed to be your perfect companion.
Built to Last
Crafted from high-quality, rugged canvas fabric, this bag is made to withstand the rigours of daily commutes and adventurous travels. We understand the need for strength, which is why it features a reinforced Nylon Weaving Belt system, providing exceptional support for heavy loads. Feel confident packing between 12-15 kg of essentials, from clothes and books to sports gear, without worrying about wear and tear. This bag is truly built for the hustle and bustle of Bangladeshi life.
Smart and Spacious Design
With generous dimensions of 21 inches x 10 inches x 11 inches and a total volume of 25 litres, this duffel hits the sweet spot between portability and capacity. The spacious main inner chamber provides ample room for all your belongings. For added convenience, it features both short straps for a quick grab-and-go carry and a long, adjustable shoulder strap for comfortable, hands-free movement while navigating crowded markets or busy train stations. The handy outer pocket ensures your phone, wallet, or tickets are always within easy reach.
Versatile for Every Occasion
This multi-purpose Travel Duffel Bag is not just for trips. Its timeless design and practical features make it an excellent choice for university students, office goers, and fitness enthusiasts. Combining robust functionality with understated style, it’s the only bag you’ll need. Upgrade your gear today and travel with confidence and ease.

products.long_description:
Travel Luggage Weight Scale Planning a dream vacation from Dhaka to Bangkok, or perhaps heading off for a business trip to Dubai? Nothing ruins the excitement of travel faster than the dreaded “higher weight” beep at the airport check-in counter. Consequently, in a time where international baggage rules are becoming stricter every day, having a Travel Luggage Weight Scale is no longer just a luxury—it is a total necessity for every Bangladeshi traveler.
Our sleek, updated luggage scale is specifically designed to give you peace of mind. Furthermore, it ensures you never have to pay another Taka in unexpected extra weight fees again.
Why Every Traveler Needs This Scale
First and foremost, accuracy is the most important factor when weighing your bags. Whether you are packing extra gifts for family abroad or bringing back heavy souvenirs, this scale provides professional-grade results. In addition to its high-precision sensors, the device is incredibly user-friendly.

Massive Capacity: You can weigh everything from a small backpack to a heavy trunk, as it supports up to 50 kg (110 lbs).

Pinpoint Precision: Moreover, with a 50 g (0.1 lb) accuracy level, you will know exactly how much room you have left for that last-minute shopping.

Dual Unit Support: You can easily switch between kg and lb with a single press of the “UNIT” button. This is particularly helpful because different airlines use different measurement standards.

Smart Features for Travel Luggage Weight Scale
In addition to its core weighing functions, we have updated this model to solve the common frustrations travelers often face. Specifically, we focused on visibility and battery life.
1. Easy-to-Read Backlit Display
For instance, have you ever tried to weigh your bags in a dimly lit hotel room? Our large LCD display features a bright green backlight. As a result, whether you are in a dark room or under the harsh sunlight of a terminal, the numbers remain crystal clear.
2. Automatic Data Locking
Another key feature is the automatic data lock. No more straining your back while trying to squint at the screen; instead, once the weight stabilizes, the scale holds the reading. Consequently, you can set the bag down and read the weight at your own pace.
3. Zero/Tare Function
Similarly, the Tare function allows you to reset the scale to zero instantly. This means you can weigh items inside a container without including the weight of the container itself.

Compact, Lightweight, and Durable
Beyond its technical specs, the best part about this Travel Luggage Weight Scale is its portability. Due to its sleek, curved design, it fits perfectly in the palm of your hand. In fact, it takes up almost zero space in your carry-on. Meanwhile, the heavy-duty strap and secure metal hook are built to lift even the bulkiest bags with ease.

Pro Tip: Always keep this scale in your hand luggage. Since it is so light, you won’t even notice it’s there—yet it can save you thousands of BDT in airline penalties!

Travel Shoe Bag
Hajj & Umrah Essential: 14″ x 11″ Travel Shoe Bag for Bangladeshi Pilgrims
Embarking on the sacred journeys of Hajj or Umrah from Bangladesh requires meticulous preparation, and our 14-inch x 11-inch travel shoe bag is an indispensable item for every pilgrim. In the crowded holy sites of Makkah and Madinah, where shoes are frequently removed and often misplaced, this compact and lightweight shoe bag offers a simple yet profound solution. It ensures your footwear – be it comfortable sandals for extensive walking during Tawaf and Sa’i, or regular shoes for moments outside of Ihram – remains clean, secure, and easily accessible.
Travel Shoe Bag (Small Size)
Made from durable, often water-resistant materials like nylon or polyester, this bag is designed to withstand the rigors of pilgrimage. It keeps dirt and dust from your shoes contained, protecting your Ihram garments and other personal belongings within your luggage from contamination. The convenient size allows you to carry your shoes discreetly into the Haram or Masjid al-Nabawi, preventing them from being mixed up with hundreds of others in shoe racks, or worse, going missing. Many pilgrims find it practical to carry their shoe bag with them during prayers, often alongside a small prayer mat and a bottle of water, keeping essential items close at hand.
For Bangladeshi pilgrims navigating the unique challenges of Hajj and Umrah, including varying weather conditions and dense crowds, this shoe bag offers immense peace of mind. It’s a small investment that contributes significantly to a smoother, more hygienic, and spiritually focused journey. Keep your footwear protected and your mind at ease, allowing you to fully concentrate on your acts of worship. This 14″ x 11″ shoe bag is more than just a storage item; it’s a practical companion for a blessed pilgrimage.
Need large shoe bag?

Tayammum mati is a unique and essential product for Muslims who perform their daily prayers. It is a type of fine-grained soil that is used in place of water for ablution (wudu) before prayer when water is not available or when using it is difficult.
Our tayammum mati is made from high-quality materials and is carefully prepared to meet the needs of Muslims in Bangladesh. The soil is free from impurities and contaminants, making it safe and hygienic for use during prayer.
It comes in a compact and convenient packaging, making it easy to carry and store. The soil is also easy to use, and it provides a comfortable and clean alternative to performing ablution with water.
Our tayammum mati is a must-have for all Muslims who want to perform their daily prayers without any hindrance, even when water is not readily available. It is a reliable and affordable product that you can trust to meet your needs.
Order your tayammum mati today and experience the ease and convenience of performing wudu even in the absence of water.

How do Tayammum

Tayammum is a ritual purification practice performed by Muslims when water is not available or when using water is not feasible due to illness, injury, or any other reason. Here are the steps to perform tayammum:

Intention: Make the intention (niyyah) in your heart that you are performing tayammum to purify yourself for prayer.
Find clean and dust-free tayammum soil: Find a clean and dust-free surface and gently strike the surface of the tayammum soil with your hands.
Strike the hands on the soil: After striking the soil, raise your hands and lightly blow off the excess soil, and then rub your hands together to remove any remaining dust.
Wipe the face: Using the same hands, wipe your face once from forehead to chin.
Wipe the arms: Then, wipe your right arm from the wrist to the elbow, and then wipe your left arm from the wrist to the elbow.
Perform prayer: Now you are ready to perform your prayer.

It is important to note that tayammum should only be performed when water is not available or when using water is not possible. If water is available and using it will not harm you, it is necessary to perform ablution (wudu) with water before prayer.

Travel USB Mini Fan for Hajj and Umrah
Get ready for your sacred journey of Hajj or Umrah with a little help to beat the heat. The “DianDi” USB Mini Fan is the perfect travel companion. It’s a stylish and simple fan that works great, keeping you cool so you can focus on your prayers and duties.
Best Travel USB Mini Fan for You
1. Strong, Quiet Breeze: This mini fan is small but powerful. It gives you a strong, natural wind that feels great. It’s also very quiet, so it won’t disturb anyone. It’s super lightweight and easy to carry. You can put it in your bag or pocket and have a personal fan with you everywhere you go.
2. Easy to Power Up: Charging this fan is very simple. It uses a modern Type-C charging port. You can plug it into a power bank, a wall charger, or even your computer. It takes just 2 to 4 hours to get a full charge. This means you won’t waste time looking for special batteries or a place to charge.
3. Use It Two Ways: The “DianDi” fan is more than just a handheld fan. It comes with a stand that you can use to place it on a table. So, you can hold it while walking around, and then set it on a desk in your hotel room for a cool breeze all night long. It’s a smart design for any traveler.
4. Simple and Good-Looking: This fan has a clean, simple look. It has one button to turn it on and off. You can also press it to change the speed. There are three speeds, so you can choose how much air you want. Its small size makes it a great gadget to take with you on any trip.
Perfect for Your Journey:
For anyone traveling for Hajj or Umrah, especially from a hot country like Bangladesh, a good Travel USB Mini Fan is a must-have. This fan is popular because it’s so easy to use and dependable. It will help you stay comfortable during your important pilgrimage.
Fan Details:

Charging Port: Type-C
Speeds: 3 options
Can be used: In your hand or on a table with a stand

Start your spiritual journey with our beautifully crafted Saving Bank—a wooden money box designed to help you save 150 000 TK easily and meaningfully. Measuring a practical 8″ × 7½″, this compact yet spacious box fits perfectly on your shelf, desk, or prayer corner.
