Made from high-quality, eco-friendly wood, this money bank features a smooth finish and elegant Islamic-inspired design. Its secure slot allows easy deposits, while a removable base ensures simple access when it’s time to collect your savings.

Capacity: Saves up to 150 000 TK

Material: Durable, premium wood with a smooth finish

Deposit Slot: Convenient and secure

Easy Access: Removable base for hassle‑free withdrawal

Design: Elegant Islamic theme, serving as an inspiring daily reminder

🎁 Perfect Gift & Personal Reminder
Looking for a thoughtful present? The Umrah Saving Bank makes a meaningful gift for family, friends, or yourself. It encourages saving habits and keeps your spiritual goal in focus every day—ideal for Ramadan, Eid, or any special occasion.

By combining gentle motivation with visible progress, this structured wooden bank promotes consistent savings—without the effort of managing multiple accounts. It’s a tangible, visual commitment to your Umrah journey that reinforces good habits and financial discipline.

The pure white color is chosen for its symbolism of purity, peace, and simplicity, helping you feel connected to the serene atmosphere of your pilgrimage. Stay Powered and Connected on Your Holy Hajj & Umrah Journey Universal Travel Adapter

products.long_description:
Unscented Detergent Sheets Keep your Ihram, clothing, and daily essentials clean , a convenient and fragrance-free laundry solution designed for modern lifestyles. These lightweight detergent sheets are easy to carry, simple to use, and suitable for both hand washing and machine washing. They are especially useful for Hajj and Umrah pilgrims who need a scent-free cleaning option for washing Ihram garments.
Each pack contains 32 detergent sheets that dissolve quickly in water and help remove dirt, sweat, and everyday stains. The compact design takes up very little space in your luggage, making these sheets an excellent travel companion for Hajj, Umrah, business trips, vacations, and daily use in Bangladesh.
Unlike traditional liquid or powder detergents, Unscented Detergent Sheets are mess-free and easy to measure. Simply use the recommended amount based on your laundry load and enjoy a hassle-free washing experience. Because they are fragrance-free, they are a practical choice for people who prefer unscented cleaning products.
These detergent sheets are made with safe and effective ingredients, including Deionized Water, Glycerol, Cellulose, Proteinase, Dispersant, Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate, and Sodium α-Enylsulfonate. The formula is designed to provide effective cleaning while remaining convenient for everyday laundry needs.
Unscented Detergent Sheets Washing Ihram

Deionized Water
Glycerol
Cellulose
Proteinase
Dispersant
Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate
Sodium α-Enylsulfonate

How to Use fragrance free detergent sheet Machine Washing

Put clothes into the washing machine.
Add the laundry detergent sheet.
Start the washing cycle.

Hand Washing ahram

Add the laundry sheet into a wash tub with water.
Add dirty clothes.
Wash as usual.

How Much to Use

½ Sheet → Small Loads
1 Sheet → Medium Loads
2–3 Sheets → Large or Heavily Soiled Loads

Why Choose Unscented Detergent Sheets?
These detergent sheets are lightweight, portable, and easy to carry during travel. They help reduce the hassle of carrying bulky detergent bottles and are suitable for washing Ihram, clothing, towels, and other washable fabrics.
Product Features

Fragrance-free formula
32 sheets per pack
Easy to carry and travel-friendly
Suitable for washing Ihram garments
Works for hand washing and machine washing
Dissolves quickly in water
Lightweight and mess-free
Safe and effective cleaning ingredients

Caution

Keep out of reach of children and pets.
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
Do not use in a dryer.
Do not ingest.
Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, seek medical attention immediately.

Performing Hajj or Umrah in the intense heat can be physically challenging, making proper hydration and cooling essential. Fill the bottle with clean water.

Lightly mist your face, arms, or clothing for instant cooling.

products.long_description:
Water Spray Mini Fan Looking for a portable cooling solution during hot summer days in Bangladesh? The mist Spray Mini Fan is designed to provide refreshing airflow and instant cooling wherever you go. Whether you are traveling, commuting, working, studying, attending outdoor events, or performing daily activities, this compact fan helps you stay comfortable even in warm weather.
One of the standout features of this Water Spray Fan is its built-in water mist spray function. Simply add water to the tank and enjoy a refreshing mist combined with powerful airflow. The mist helps reduce heat and provides a cooling sensation, making it ideal for hot and humid conditions.
This fan comes with 5 adjustable speed levels, allowing you to choose the airflow that best suits your comfort. From a gentle breeze to stronger cooling power, you can easily customize the fan speed according to your needs.
The included neck hanging strap offers hands-free convenience. You can wear the fan around your neck while walking, shopping, traveling, exercising, or working. Its lightweight and portable design makes it easy to carry throughout the day.
The fan features 180-degree rotation, allowing you to adjust the direction of airflow for maximum comfort. Whether you want the breeze directed toward your face or another angle, the flexible design makes positioning simple and convenient.
Powered by a rechargeable battery, the Water Spray Mini Fan provides approximately 2 to 3 hours of backup time on a full charge. The package includes a USB charging cable, making charging easy through power banks, laptops, desktop computers, USB adapters, and other compatible devices.
With an input voltage of 5V, this fan offers efficient and reliable performance. The automatic cooling effect created by the combination of airflow and mist helps you feel refreshed during hot days.
Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, the Water Spray Mini Fan is suitable for students, office workers, travelers, pilgrims, outdoor enthusiasts, and anyone looking for a convenient personal cooling device.

products.long_description:
A Women Hajj Hair Cut Scissor (Kachi) is a specially designed grooming tool created to meet the spiritual and practical needs of Muslim women during the sacred pilgrimage of Hajj and Umrah. After completing the essential rites, women are required to trim a small portion of their hair as a symbolic act of humility and devotion. This custom scissor is thoughtfully crafted to make that important moment easy, safe, and convenient.
Made from high-quality stainless steel, the Hajj women custom scissor offers durability, rust resistance, and long-lasting sharpness. Its compact and lightweight design allows it to fit easily into a handbag, pouch, or Hajj kit without taking up space. The blades are precisely aligned to ensure a clean and smooth cut with minimal effort, making it suitable for quick use in crowded environments such as Mina or Muzdalifah.
The scissor often features an ergonomic handle designed for a comfortable grip, allowing better control and reducing hand strain. Some designs come with rounded tips for added safety, ensuring peace of mind while trimming hair in a busy pilgrimage setting. Many versions are also available with protective covers to maintain hygiene and prevent accidental cuts when stored.
Beyond practicality, this scissor represents a meaningful part of a woman’s Hajj journey. It is not just a grooming accessory but a symbolic tool that helps fulfill a sacred obligation. Some suppliers offer personalized or decorative options, making it a thoughtful gift for family members or groups traveling together for pilgrimage.
Compact, hygienic, and purpose-built, the Women Hajj Hair Cut Scissor (Kachi) is an essential addition to every female pilgrim’s travel kit, ensuring that this important ritual is completed with ease, dignity, and convenience.

Prepare for your sacred journey with this women Hajj hijab, thoughtfully designed for comfort, modesty, and ease during Hajj and Umrah. Made from 100% pure cotton, this hijab is soft, breathable, and lightweight—ideal for hot weather. It helps keep you cool and comfortable so you can stay focused on your عبادah.
This ready-to-wear hijab (khimar) is simple and convenient for everyone to use. Just slip it on and adjust it around your head and chest for full coverage. You can get ready in under 20 seconds, making it perfect for busy moments during pilgrimage. The pre-stitched design ensures a secure and comfortable fit without the need for pins.
The fabric is gentle on the skin and suitable for long hours of wear. It provides proper coverage of the hair, neck, and ears, while keeping the face open, as required during Hajj. The white color reflects simplicity, unity, and purity—values that are important during this spiritual journey.
Each package includes one hijab, an under-hijab cap, and a mask, offering a practical and complete solution. This makes it easier for pilgrims to manage daily needs during travel and worship.
Designed as a free size (front 32 inches, back 42 inches), this hijab comfortably fits most adult users. It is recommended to keep multiple hijabs during Hajj and Umrah for hygiene and convenience.
This Pure Cotton Hijab for Hajj is suitable for women from all backgrounds, body types, and experience levels. Whether it is your first pilgrimage or you have traveled before, this hijab supports your journey with comfort, dignity, and ease.

Women Essential list for perform hajj or umrah
When it comes to performing Hajj or Umrah, there are certain items that women need to have with them. Some of the essential items for women to perform Hajj or Umrah include:

Ihram clothing: Women should have two pieces of plain white clothing that cover their entire body, called “Ihram.” They can wear any loose, comfortable clothing that covers their entire body, including their head.
Headscarf: Women should bring a headscarf or hijab to cover their hair and neck.
Comfortable footwear: Women should have comfortable and sturdy footwear that they can wear throughout their pilgrimage.
Personal hygiene items: Women should bring their personal hygiene items, including soap, shampoo, toothbrush, toothpaste, and any other personal hygiene items they may need.
Medications: If women have any prescribed medications, they should bring enough for the entire pilgrimage.
Money: Women should have enough money to cover their expenses during the pilgrimage, such as food, transportation, and accommodation.
Passport and travel documents: Women should have their passport and travel documents with them at all times.

It is important to note that there may be additional items that women need to bring based on their personal needs and preferences. It’s always a good idea to consult with a trusted travel agent or an experienced Hajj or Umrah guide to ensure that you have all the necessary items for a safe and comfortable pilgrimage.

Tayammum mati: You need to take ozu at air. Some times there is shortage of water in airline. So doing tayammum is very important this times.

কালার কোডেড তাজভীদ – সঠিক উচ্চারণ নিশ্চিত করুন সহজ বাংলা অনুবাদ ও উচ্চারণ – যারা আরবি পড়তে পারে না, তাদের জন্য সহায়ক ১০০ GSM প্রিমিয়াম গ্লসি পেপার – আরামদায়ক পড়ার অভিজ্ঞতা হার্ড ব্যাক + ডাস্ট কাভার – দীর্ঘস্থায়ী ব্যবহার উপযোগী
